recognition_cue: Several short paired nucleotide-fragment ribbons with visibly terminated ends.
visual_meaning: A category cue for a DNA-fragment preparation; it intentionally avoids a complete genome or generic spinning-helix metaphor.

motion_contract.entrance: Assemble short fragments independently, then reveal the specification gate.
motion_contract.ambient: Use a restrained two-axis drift across fragment groups; no full rotation.
motion_contract.resolve: Endpoints land before route or evidence information appears.
host_rules: Animate fragment wrappers, not individual rungs, unless the shot is a close-up.
Never rotate the actor as one complete helix.
Break or desaturate the specification gate for unknown-version state.
Keep all motion finite and owned by the host timeline.

chapter_open.purpose: Introduce the fragment preparation without turning it into a generic genome symbol.

continuity_anchor.purpose: Keep the fragment identity present while route or formulation leads.

diagram_node.purpose: Represent the specified preparation inside a route or formula map.

evidence_companion.purpose: Hold subject continuity beside route, population and study-quality fields.

recap_token.purpose: Return terminated fragments as a simple closing marker.

unknown_version.purpose: Interrupt the identity when source, fragment profile or route is missing.

reentry.first_appearance: Assemble the short fragments and land their endpoints once.
reentry.later_appearances: Use a short endpoint lock or match-position return; never repeat a full helix spin.
reentry.chapter_return: Keep fragment count, direction and termination marks stable.

recognition_tests.small_size_mode: Keep three short fragments and their endpoints; suppress most internal rungs.

disclosure: Illustrative ingredient actor. Source, fragment profile, concentration, formulation and route require product-specific evidence.
